root_cause: The tenant Data Sovereignty API returned raw last_change_impact audit payload in customer GET and POST JSON, which contained change actor, before/after policy and internal evidence IDs even though the portal interface did not render these fields.
prevention: Project the tenant-safe response server-side for every customer GET and POST.
Preserve the full Supabase EU audit ledger and authenticated internal-only canonical administration view.
Expose only review status, normalized change type and non-materiality ESRS candidate identifiers; never infer validated compliance.
Verify no actor, change ID, before/after or evidence references are present in the customer JSON.

evidence.outcome: Customer API redaction implemented on both GET and POST; production readback pending
